retrievalProfile.description: A nocturnal urban scene featuring ghostly, semi-transparent figures in a wet alleyway, topped with sharp geometric and script typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, low-contrast night scene in a wet city alley where human figures appear as translucent apparitions, framed by a top-heavy typographic layout featuring a mix of thin sans-serif and aggressive, slanted script.
coreVisualRelationships: Translucent figures against a dark, reflective ground
Warm orange typography contrasting with cool blue-grey shadows
Horizontal rule lines intersecting with dynamic script

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five semi-transparent figures arranged horizontally across the mid-ground, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, slanted script logo in the upper center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright script, move down through the ghostly figures, and follow the wet reflections toward the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured alley walls on the left and right provide a frame for the central action.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and muted grey-blue (background and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange and coral (typography and horizontal lines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights from street lamps and typography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Slanted brush script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script features a 45-degree slant to the right
Sharp, pointed terminals on the script
Horizontal cross-bar extending through the entire word
Secondary text is ultra-thin, wide-tracked sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'N' and 't' in the script have elongated tails that frame the word.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, organic script paired with rigid, airy geometric sans-serif.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top text

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-tracked secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-contrast, grainy photograph of a wet city alley at night with five semi-transparent, ghostly figures standing in a row. Street lamps should create soft, glowing flares.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, orange slanted script logo in the upper center. Above it, place a thin coral-colored horizontal line broken by wide-tracked uppercase sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the script slanted and sharp?
Is the color palette dominated by cool blues and warm orange accents?
Is the top text extremely wide-tracked?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the wet ground reflections

mustAchieve: Clean vector-style typography over textured photo

postGenerationChecks: Check for the 'ghostly' transparency effect on all subjects.
Ensure the horizontal rule at the top is perfectly straight.
Verify the script does not touch the figures.
Confirm the wet ground has vertical light reflections.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban night photography + double exposure transparency + 80s slanted script + wide-tracked geometric headers.
